## Runs 6–7 — D = 0 SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), raw before frequency read

Run 6: region-A electron point n = +3.20 × 10¹² cm⁻², B 0→10 T, 921/921 points. Run 7: region-A hole point n = −1.20 × 10¹² cm⁻², B 10→0.3 T, 486/486 points. Both used the run-5 calibration, the fixed B_1–B_2 Rxx channel, and 50 µV sr1 sensitivity. The raw traces below retain the full magnetoresistance and show the high-field envelope before any detrending.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run, sdh_fft
_data_dir = Path('/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02/data')
def run(i):
    return open_run(_data_dir / str(i))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6), sharex=True)
for k, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    q = run(rid)
    B = q.col('magnet_field')
    R = q.col('sr1_X') / (q.col('sr0_X') / -1e6)
    order = np.argsort(B)
    ax[k].plot(B[order], R[order], lw=1)
    ax[k].set_ylabel('Rxx (Ohm)')
    ax[k].set_title(f'run {rid}: raw B_1–B_2, ' + ('electron' if rid == 6 else 'hole'))
    print(summarize_run(q))
    print(f'  raw Rxx {np.nanmin(R):.1f}..{np.nanmax(R):.1f} Ohm; T_sample {np.nanmin(q.col("T_sample")):.3f}..{np.nanmax(q.col("T_sample")):.3f} K; '
          f'max |I_tg| {np.nanmax(np.abs(q.col("k_2400_tg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA, max |I_bg| {np.nanmax(np.abs(q.col("k_2400_bg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA')
ax[-1].set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6), sharex=True)
for k, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    q = run(rid)
    B = q.col('magnet_field'); R = q.col('sr1_X') / (q.col('sr0_X') / -1e6)
    order = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[order], R[order]
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=1.0 if rid == 6 else 0.3, r_full_scale=5000)
    print(f'run {rid}: {on.summary()}')
    for lo, style in ((1.0, '-'), (1.5, '--')):
        F, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, 8.0), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        y = S[0] / max(S[0])
        ax[k].plot(F, y, style, label=f'{lo}–8 T')
    ax[k].set_xlim(0, 42); ax[k].set_ylabel('FFT amplitude / max')
    ax[k].set_title(f'run {rid}: B detrended, resampled in 1/B')
    ax[k].legend()
ax[-1].set_xlabel('frequency F (T)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read / next:** Run 6 has a persistent electron-side component near 7.2 T across the usable 1–8 T window; the near 14/22/29 T peaks form a near-integer comb and cannot yet be called independent surfaces. The onset tracker finds that ~7 T component already present at the 1 T edge of the well-sampled record (censored); the 50 mT points below 1 T undersample it and do not establish an earlier onset. Run 7 has a ~6–7 T component and a possible ~12 T component, but at n = −1.2 × 10¹² it sits in the model's close, balanced near-CNP hole regime; it is not a clean stacking discriminator. Neither run railed (raw Rxx < 590 Ohm versus 5 kOhm full scale), and the recorded Keithley currents remained below 0.22 nA. The fan will follow the electron side at n = +2.5…+3.2 × 10¹², D = 0, with a 0.9 T low edge that tests the censored onset on a Nyquist-safe grid; frequency branches across n, not these one-point peak amplitudes, will carry the call.

## HERA — Step 4: region-A electron Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti: region-A electron n +2.5..+3.2e12 D=0; B 0.9->8 T uniform 1/B, 100x27, fast\_delay 2.7 s, sr1 50 uV; ends B 8 T gates 0 · **ETA ~09:11** (≈3h45m)

Runs 6 and 7 are complete and read in ana cells 14–17. The electron cut (run 6, +3.2 × 10¹² cm⁻²) has a persistent ~7.3 T tone and a 14/22/29 T near-integer comb; a separate heavy pocket is unresolved at one density. The hole cut is confined to −1.2 × 10¹², where the forward model predicts a close near-CNP pair and ABCA is LK-suppressed. I choose one electron fan on the run-5 calibrated D = 0 line, n = +2.5…+3.2 × 10¹², to test whether the ~7 T branch and higher peaks follow separate F(n) curves. The parallel CNP ridge in run 5 implies a second region shifted by ~0.43 × 10¹²; extraction will inspect the possible mosaic tones before a region-A stacking call.

**Coverage and grid:** B = 0.9→8.0 T, 100 rows uniform in 1/B; 27 n points (Δn = 0.0269 × 10¹²). At n_max, F_L = 33.1 T and Δ(1/B) = 0.00996 T⁻¹ gives ~3.0 rows per fastest period. At B_lo, a fourfold LL ray spans 0.087 × 10¹² in n, giving ~3.2 n points per ray. The model gives the lowest-n ABAB light tone ~5.2 T, yielding ~5.1 periods across this field window; δF = 1.01 T and the ABAB heavy–ABCA split is >5 T. The grid starts 0.1 T below the censored 1 T electron onset: run 6's 50 mT points below 1 T under-sample a 7 T tone, so those points cannot establish a lower onset. The fan tests it with a Nyquist-safe grid. B > 8 T is excluded because the period and separation checks already close; n < +2.5 is excluded because the light-tone period count fails and low-n/high-B resistance increases. Thus this fan does not test the hole side or the low-density exception regime.

**Acquisition and price:** Fixed sr1 sensitivity 50 µV gives 5 kΩ full scale at the 10 nA drive; runs 6–7 stayed below 0.59 kΩ even at 10 T. Fast dwell 2.7 s = 9τ for the observed 0.3 s, 24 dB lock-in; magnet set blocks and settles 3 s per row. Expected 100 × 27 × (2.7 s + ~0.13 s read overhead from run 5) = 127 min, plus 0→0.9 T positioning 7 min, 0.9→8 T field traverse 52 min, ~10 min rows/flyback: ~3 h 16 min, priced **3 h 45 min** including operating margin. Field ends at 8 T; gates return to 0 V. Preconditions printed and asserted in the cell: live base thermometry, B near 0, Si 0, magnet PS/output, lock-in τ/slope and drive, committed caps. Check first two landed rows for leakage >1 nA, clipped/flat Rxx and wrong setpoint tracking; then check roughly every 20 rows for temperature drift, channel integrity and whether the fan branches disperse. Stop on an anomaly; field-ramp interruption alone does not stop the VTI supply (rig card Magnet).

# D = 0 electron fan for FS count: run-5 calibration; run-6 onset and tones.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_fan = np.linspace(2.5, 3.2, 27)  # 1e12 cm^-2, region A
D_fan = np.zeros_like(n_fan)
Vtg_fan, Vbg_fan = calc_gate_voltages(n_fan, D_fan, **CAL_FAN)
B_fan = 1.0 / np.linspace(1/0.9, 1/8.0, 100)  # uniform in 1/B, ascending B

# Session caps and whole-grid validators: all failures happen before movement.
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, SI_MIN, SI_MAX, B_SESSION_CAP, T_SESSION_CAP) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, -25.0, 25.0, 10.0, 100.0)
assert np.all((Vtg_fan >= TG_MIN) & (Vtg_fan <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((Vbg_fan >= BG_MIN) & (Vbg_fan <= BG_MAX))
assert np.all(np.abs(B_fan) <= B_SESSION_CAP)
for p, values in ((k_tg.volt, Vtg_fan), (k_bg.volt, Vbg_fan), (magnet.field, B_fan)):
    p.vals.validate(float(values.min()))
    p.vals.validate(float(values.max()))
_ncheck, _Dcheck = calc_nD(Vtg_fan, Vbg_fan, **CAL_FAN)
assert np.max(np.abs(_ncheck - n_fan)) < 1e-3 and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck)) < 1e-3

# Silent preconditions: state inherited from the handoff/state0, not set by this cell.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_tau, _slope, _drive = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope(), sr1.amplitude()
print(f'precondition T_sample={_T:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (0.8..1.6), '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), Si={_Si:+.3f} V (0), PS={_ps}, output={_out}; '
      f'sr1 tau={_tau} s (0.3), slope={_slope} dB (24), drive={_drive:.3f} V (~1)')
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and 0.8 <= _Tv <= 1.6
assert abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_Si) < 0.01 and _ps and _out
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 0.03 and _slope == 24 and 0.9 <= _drive <= 1.1
print(f'fan grid: {len(B_fan)} B x {len(n_fan)} n; B {B_fan[0]:.3f}..{B_fan[-1]:.3f} T, '
      f'n {n_fan[0]:.3f}..{n_fan[-1]:.3f}e12, '
      f'TG {Vtg_fan.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_fan.max():+.4f} V, BG {Vbg_fan.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_fan.max():+.4f} V')

sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # 5 kOhm full scale at ~10 nA
mc = dict(meas_config)
mc['Si (V)'] = _Si
mc['sample_temperature:'] = _T
mc['comments'] = 'landau-fan-vti electron: region A, run-5 D=0 calibration; n +2.5..+3.2e12, B 0.9..8 T, 100x27 uniform-1/B, fast_delay 2.7 s, sr1 50 uV'
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('region A electron, D=0 V/nm, n=+2.5..+3.2e12 cm^-2, B=0.9..8.0 T ascending uniform-1/B 100 rows x 27 n; run-5 c_bg/c_tg=0.773, n_offset=-0.0894e12, D_offset=-0.013 V/nm; sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s, 24 dB, fast_delay 2.7 s')

# Move gates at base field, then position magnet (blocking ~7 min). No separate settle sleep.
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_fan[0]))
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_fan[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
s.ramp(magnet.field, float(B_fan[0]))

# [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', sr0.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot('time', sr1.P)

def fan_leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if not np.isfinite(i_tg + i_bg) or i_tg > 1e-9 or i_bg > 1e-9:
        print(f'LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_fan], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_fan, Vbg_fan], slow_delay=0, fast_delay=2.7)
# The field remains at the run endpoint; the gates return to the bring-up value.
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0)
print(f'fan done: B={magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates=({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V')
